stage_2_range_contract.reason: Rocket-Pod has 41 successful integer hit rolls at short range and 51 at long range. Distance at or below short_range is worse.

combat_ordering.verification: Zero combat-order mismatches verify the snapshot fix. They do not show that live sequential positions were equal.
combat_ordering.ml_behavior: Aim, range, turret alignment, and fire use the observation-batch target position.
combat_ordering.stock_asymmetry: Stock droids use live sequential target positions. Record this asymmetry in the incumbent benchmark report.
combat_ordering.instant_hit_warning: Re-audit the temporary target-position override before an instant-hit weapon is used.

accepted_divergences.detail: The simulator does not model the engine bumpTime gate or moving-target lead for misses.
accepted_divergences.scope: Accepted only for Rocket-Pod V1 with no splash damage.
accepted_divergences.follow_up: Model bump bookkeeping and target lead before mixed weapons or splash damage.

accepted_divergences.detail: The simulator uses center distance. The engine can collide with the target surface earlier.
accepted_divergences.scope: The simulator must never apply damage before the engine trace. It may lag by at most one 100 ms update.
accepted_divergences.follow_up: Model projectile and target collision shapes before the one-update lag bound becomes material.

v2_slot_rule_required_before_expansion.v1_behavior: The fixed roster is assigned on the first observation and never compacted.

result.win: opposing team loses all combat units first
result.loss: evaluated team loses all combat units first
result.draw: both teams lose their final unit in the same engine update
result.unfinished: time limit expires while both teams have a combat unit
